scores.evidence: The s4-sort flowchart (flowchart TD) fills one 390 px screen with readable Japanese labels and a caption (pages/mobile-jp-18.png, mobile-jp-19.png). The code blocks s3-code and p-model-code soft-wrap on mobile, the line numbers stay readable, and nothing is cut off (mobile-jp-12/13, mobile-jp-29/30). metrics: overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors.

Desktop charsPerLine median is 39, inside the 30–40 target (max 49). Every desktop screen has a heading, figure, code block or check. One mobile screen counts as text-only: mobile-jp-04, which shows the end of s1-defs and the s1-pick/s1-table list. The three-paragraph s2-goal run spans mobile-jp-07/08 before the next prompt box.

All visible text is Japanese, including the diagram labels, and the diagram has a caption (図1). No Japanese words break mid-word, and contrast is good on the callouts (s3-pitfall red, s4-names blue). The bottom bar hides no controls: every 答える button is fully visible (mobile-jp-06, 09, 15, 20, 22).

niceToHave: s3-steps / p-steps: each step title starts with a circled number (①…⑧) right next to the reader's own numbered circle, so every step shows its number twice (pages/mobile-jp-10.png, mobile-jp-23.png). Consider dropping the leading ①–⑧ from the titles but keeping the references like 「①の依頼文」.

s3-code / p-model-code: at 390 px, lines 2, 3, 5, 13 and 17 wrap. The `=> {` lands alone on the next line (pages/mobile-jp-13.png, mobile-jp-29.png, mobile-jp-30.png). It is still readable. Shorter test names, for example 'ハイフンなし' instead of '「3桁-4桁」の郵便番号は true', would keep most lines whole.

s2-goal-prompt, s3-prompt-write, s3-prompt-green, p-prompt-write, p-prompt-green, p-prompt-review: these prompt boxes show literal backticks (for example `isPostalCode`) as plain text (pages/mobile-jp-08.png, mobile-jp-12.png, mobile-jp-26.png). This is intended for copy-paste, but learners may wonder whether to type the backticks.
mobile-jp-04 is the only text-only mobile screen (s1-defs + s1-table list). It is acceptable, but s1-table could become a two-column table (確認 / 依頼文に足す一言) for easier scanning.
reader: the full-length mobile PNG (mobile-jp.png) stops at 16000 px. This review used the per-screen PNGs.
reader: the desktop side panel shows the 未回答 badge on every section above the current one in the TOC. That is expected, but it adds noise in screenshots.
summary: The lesson renders cleanly at 390 px and 1440 px. No overflow, console, mermaid, block or image errors. The review flowchart and both test files stay readable on mobile, and no personal data (account names, private titles, paths, keys or billing) appears on any screen. Nothing blocks the lesson; the main polish item is the duplicated step numbers (①… next to the reader's numbered circles) in s3-steps and p-steps.
